Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: one opaque depth background plate for a high quality 2D side-view fighting videogame, original Yautja clan setting 'Atrium des Médiateurs'. This is an ORIGINAL lore-compatible clan meeting environment, not a certified canonical film location. The supplied production concept is a MATERIAL AND ARCHITECTURAL VOCABULARY REFERENCE only: broad layered geological canopy shelters, low tough alien structures and practical mechanical integration. Do not copy the exact reference location, text, logo, presentation border, or any people.
Landscape composition requested 1536x1024 or wider. Camera level, horizontal side-view fighting-stage perspective looking toward the middle/distant side of an expansive atrium open onto an arid canyon. Only mid-distance and distant environment in this image. NO nearby playable platform, NO foreground combat floor, NO foot contact line, no foreground framing columns. Lowest quarter continues soft depth of canyon and distant lower architecture, never a black void. Calm open central lower area for separate fighters and independently layered foreground assets.
Scene: a neutral sheltered meeting court between Yautja clan houses, low wide roofs of overlapping naturally stratified stone slabs supported by practical curved ribbed dark alien alloy structures. A broad recessed meeting lodge is distant across the open court, no royal throne, no statue, no human temple. A few small low functional mechanical console alcoves and integrated cable conduits in the distant architecture. Geological terrace banks and pale eroded canyon walls beyond, sophisticated compact equipment embedded into weathered stone. Soft indirect overcast daylight, ivory haze and cool desaturated bronze, slate stone, subdued warm recessed slit lights as accents. Strong coherent perspective, grounded roofs on real supports, clear long distance and correct scale. Original design should feel physically constructed by technological hunter clans, not generic magical fantasy.
Style: detailed realistic painterly videogame environment with restrained contrast and atmospheric depth, spatially clear and polished. No people, creatures, ships, text, watermark, symbols pasted on surfaces, gothic pointed arches, medieval battlements, giant mask faces, deities, floating objects, burning braziers, huge throne, humanoid statues or human heraldry. This depth plate must not include a combat floor.
